text: Gurubashi Arena Grand Master is a pvp achievement earned for looting the Arena Master trinket from the Gurubashi Arena and completing the Arena Grandmaster quest.
Gwen Armstead was the mayor of the town of Duskhaven in Gilneas. She is involved in several quests throughout the worgen starting experience of Gilneas.
The Haal'eshi are a group of arakkoa found at Den of Haal'esh and Haal'eshi Gorge in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Altar of Aggonar is located in the Haal'eshi Gorge of Hellfire Peninsula. It summons the elemental Aeranas.

This sporty umbrella can protect up to 3 creatures from rain and harsh sunlight. Its cunningly shaped panels also spin when a strong wind rushes through them, while a gyroscopic stabilizer keeps the umbrella steady in its user’s hand. This improvement over ordinary umbrellas was designed to keep the gyroparasol from blowing away in storms, but it has proven remarkably useful for slowing down falling heroes.
Gyrochoppa Seat Belt is a quest reward from Get to the Gyrochoppa!

Gyreworms are earth elementals in the shape of a tunneling worm and are native to Deepholm. They have also appeared in Kezan literally eating away at the Kajaro Trading Company's profits, Kaja'mite. Their purpose appears to simply be eating away rock and minerals. Earth elementals serving under Therazane the Stonemother consider these worms as vermin. The earth elementals also fear them and consider them dangerous.

Guse's War Rider is a wyvern found in Alterac Valley. If successfully summoned by its master, Wing Commander Guse, it hovers outside Dun Baldar and bombards members of the Alliance from above. The summoning quest is Call of Air - Guse's Fleet.

Guzzling Patrons can be found at the Grim Guzzler in Blackrock Depths. They are initially neutral, but will become hostile (along with all other mobs in the bar) if Plugger Spazzring is killed or has Grim Guzzler Key pickpocketed from him.
Gusting Elementals were part of the Elemental Unrest pre-cursor to Cataclysm, and could be found across many different zones.
The Gurubashi Challenge Flag is provided as an objective for the following quests: * Gurubashi Challenge: Free-For-All Arena Combat * Gurubashi Challenge It summons a Gurubashi Arena Challenger.
Hacker's Leggings is a quest reward from Hacking the Construct.

The Gurubashi civil war was an internal conflict that occurred between a coalition of Zandalari and Gurubashi trolls (including Hakkari priests) against Atal'ai fanatics loyal to the loa Hakkar the Soulflayer, in the Gurubashi Empire around 1,500 years before the First War. The conflict was the result of the increasingly costly sacrificial demands of Hakkar the Soulflayer, whom the Gurubashi worshipped. In return for vast conquests, the Soulflayer demanded increasingly larger amounts of blood sacrifices, ultimately culminating in his attempted summoning by his Atal'ai zealots. While initially unconcerned, the Zandalari trolls soon came to the conclusion that Hakkar would drive the Gurubashi

Gus Rustflutter is a goblin found at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris. Thinking his wife Chelsea has been poisoned by the nearby scorpids, he asks adventurers to help her by collecting their poison glands.

__NOTOC__ The Gyrochoppa Pilot is perhaps the only gnome encountered by goblin players in their secondary starting zone. The Pilot can be found at the Alliance Beachhead on the Lost Isles, working on his Gyrochoppa. He is none too pleased when players come to steal it from him.
The Gyrochoppa is a gyrocopter hovering at the far end of the Alliance Beachhead on the Lost Isles. It can be used to travel to the nearby Alliance ship, the Vengeance Wake.
Gust Soldiers are unbound air elementals located in Vortex Pinnacle.
Gurthalak, Voice of the Deeps drops from Madness of Deathwing in Dragon Soul.
Gurubashi Cauldron-Mixers are jungle trolls found in Mandokir's Domain in Zul'Gurub.
Gurubashi Shadow Hunters are jungle trolls found in the Temple of Bethekk in Zul'Gurub.
Gusini is a jungle troll warlock trainer located at Sen'jin Village in Durotar. He is on the second floor of the largest hut, speaking with Bomsanchu and Parata.
Ha'srim was a Highborne whose dead body was found by Jarod Shadowsong and was second murdered first being Thera'brin.
Gurubashi Bloodriders are found attacking Zouchin Village in Kun-Lai Summit during Enemies At Our Door.
Hackiss is a saurok held in a cage in Fire Camp Ruqin in Kun-Lai Summit. He is also found at the Temple of the White Tiger. He is the tank for a P.U.G. participating in the Trial of the White Tiger.

__NOTOC__ Gutretch is a ghoul master Pet Tamer located at the top of the stairway leading from Crystalsong Forest into Zul'Drak. He is surrounded by his three level 25 battle pets: Fleshrender, Blight, and Cadavus. Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Northrend achievement.
The Gustwalker Staff drops from Wing Leader Ner'onok in the Siege of Niuzao Temple.
Gurubashi Bloodlords are Gurubashi jungle trolls taking part to the fight of Horridon during the second door.
Gurubashi Venom Priests are Gurubashi tribe jungle trolls taking part to the fight of Horridon at the second door. They are a total of three during this phase.
__NOTOC__ Gurthan Iron Maws are quilen located at Mogu'shan Palace. They can be found guarding the doors while fighting one another or patrolling around the entrance.
Gyrotilt is a goblin located in the Northern Barrens. He is the one that drives the Silver Bullet X-831 during The Short Way Home.
Gyasi is a tol'vir reagent vendor located at Ramkahen in Uldum. He appears in the Vision of the Twisting Sands where he can be saved.

The Gurthan clan is a clan of mogu that have traveled from an unknown location to the Mogu'shan Palace to pay tribute to their king while seeking to prove themselves amongst their rival clans of Harthak and Kargesh. This clan favors the use of fist weapons and prizes their quilen companions.
Gurubashi Workers are trolls appearing in the instanced and uninstanced versions of Zul'Gurub. In the instance, they appear as level 84-85 forest trolls.
Gurubashi Spirits are dire trolls seen during Jin'do's encounter in Zul'Gurub. They are used to body slam the soul chains of Hakkar.
__NOTOC__ Gurun is a gronnling located at Gurun's Banquet in Frostfire Ridge.

__NOTOC__ Guttra Wolfchew is the ogre that leads the Grimfrost clan at Grimfrost Hill in Frostfire Ridge. As his name implies, he has a taste for frost wolves, as he can be found eating one, with another chained up nearby.
__NOTOC__ Gutgore is a boar located in Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge. Its master is General Vul'gath.
Gurun's Banquet is found on the Burning Glacier just outside of Frostwall in south-central Frostfire Ridge. Inside are a squad of Frostfire Gronnlings led by Gurun, son of Skog.

Gurubashi Villagers are trolls found in the northeastern area of Zul'Gurub. Some of them approach and kneel before Mortaxx who tells them to "CLIMB". They then proceed to climb a nearby pyramid and are sacrificed in a ritual at the top.
Gyro-Mechanic Lavenderp is a gnome located at the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. She's a mechanic specialized in gyrocopter upkeep.
Guse is an orc quest giver found at Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.
HM may refer to: * Hard Mode, now called Elite mode, an increased difficulty by encounter mechanics. * Highmaul, a raid instance in .

Haagios is a draenei located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
__NOTOC__ Gussof Forgefire is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, he appears in Stormwind Harbor, preparing armor polish for the troops.

Gyran'zul is a Zandalari troll shaman who joined his fellow shaman in expressing concerns after a storm appeared to delay the Zandalari from attacking Zouchin Village. When Khal'ak arrived to address their concerns, Gyran'zul informed her that while the loa talked to the Zandalari and the Darkspear, their attention was focused elsewhere.

Gurubashi Refugees are trolls found in the northeastern area of Zul'Gurub, near the Cache of Madness and almost outside the gates of Temple of Bethekk. They can be found sitting or lying down throughout the area that they are located in.
Gyrexle, the Eternal Mechanic is a mechagnome located at the Overlook Ruins in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Haakun the All-Consuming is a draenei located at in Talador.
Gyroscopic Internal Stabilizer is a piece of naval equipment that counters the Chaotic Whirlpools threat in naval Garrison Missions.
__NOTOC__ Gutrek is an ogre located at the Earthshaker Gorge in .
Gygax is the grandfather of Delvar Ironfist. He trained his grandson when Delvar was "just a lad".
__NOTOC__ Guviena Bladesong is a night elven priestess located in Lightsong in Val'sharah.
Gurubashi Witch Doctors are jungle trolls located in Isle of Reckoning in Kun-Lai Summit.
Gurubashi Headsplitters are jungle trolls located on the Isle of Reckoning in Kun-Lai Summit.
Gurubashi Hexxers are jungle trolls located in Zouchin Province in Kun-Lai Summit.
Gurubashi Stalkers are jungle trolls located in Zouchin Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Gurubashi Worshippers are jungle trolls located on the Isle of Reckoning in Kun-Lai Summit.
Gurubashi Soul-Seekers are jungle trolls located in of Northern Stranglethorn.
__NOTOC__ Habrok is an owl ghost located at the Fields of the Eternal Hunt in Halls of Valor during the quest Night of the Wilds.
Gutmook is a trogg shaman featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Gutmook is a trogg who appears to be the leader of the troggs underground.

Habutu is a Zandalari troll located at the Golden Throne in Dazar'alor, working as one of God King Rastakhan's closest bodyguards along his sister. When Warlord Kao and the Kao-Tien launched their attack on Warport Rastari, Rastakhan sent the siblings and the Speaker of the Horde to deal with the threat. He ordered for the Rastari Defenders to be rallied together and ordered the deaths of Kao's lieutenants Jao-Ti the Thunderous and Subjugator Zheng. After they discovered from Vilnak'dor that the mogu were a distraction to lure the siblings away from Rastakhan's side, the pair rushed back to warn Rastakhan's about Zul's betrayal. However before he could inform the King of what he had discover
__NOTOC__ Habdash is an ogre located in the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.

H17 Ammunition Buddy was never made available. This item would presumably have worked the same way as similar items such as the Ultrasafe Bullet Machine. However, with the removal of ammo in the same expansion, it was cut before launch.
Gustave, the Gutripper is Hagatha the Witch's pet crocolisk and can be encountered as a boss in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone.
Gurubashi Raptor is a raptor located in Northern Stranglethorn.
Gurubashi Riding Raptors are raptors located in Kun-Lai Summit.
Gusting Axebeak Anklewraps drop from Murderbeak in Zuldazar.
Gurubashi Spirit Warriors are dire trolls seen guarding the Altar of the Blood God in Zul'Gurub, prior to Jin'do's encounter.
Gutgut is the carrion bird pet of Shath'kar, located near the eastern end of the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun.
Gurubashi Bloodragers are jungle trolls located in Zul'Gurub near The Devil's Terrace found near the lake. They are mounted on raptors.
Gurubashi Behemoth is a jungle dire troll located in Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn.
Gurubashi Bloodfuries are jungle trolls located in Northern Stranglethorn. They attacked Grom'Gol Base Camp and Rebel Camp.
Gurubashi Crushers are jungle dire trolls located in Northern Stranglethorn.
Gurubashi Shadows are three dire trolls located at the base of the Altar of the Blood God in Zul'Gurub.
Gurubashi Soldiers are jungle trolls located in Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn.
Gurubashi War-Seekers are forest trolls located in Northern Stranglethorn. They attacked Grom'Gol Base Camp and Rebel Camp.
Gurubashi Sacrifices are captured jungle trolls located in Tal'gurub in Zuldazar. They were captured by the Jambani.
Gurubashi Voodoo Daddies are jungle trolls located in Zuldazar.
Gutgnash is a crocolisk located in Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest during On Track.
Habradu is a Zandalari troll located at the Village in the Vines in Zuldazar.
__NOTOC__ Gwugnug the Cursed is a dire troll zombie located in a cave in the Primal Wetlands in Nazmir.
Gwugnug's Cursed Wraps drop from Gwugnug the Cursed in Nazmir.
Gurthani Tablets are found in the Terrace of Gurthan in the Dread Wastes.
Gurthani the Elder is a jungle troll located on the expedition isles.
Gyro-Radiant Reflector can be bought from the followers with the engineering trait in the garrisons for . It used to be sold by Miri Fiddlewizz in Boralus.

Gurubashi Arena Challenger come in various races and classes to participate in the Gurubashi Arena fights in the Cape of Stranglethorn. They are summoned by Gurubashi Challenge Flag.
Gurubashi Speaker is a jungle troll present in Zanchul in Dazar'alor during Talanji's coronation.
Guzbert Gizmoflank is a gnome explosives expert located in Vol'dun. He was killed by a san'layn when he drained his blood, exploding him and leaving only his skeleton.
H'partho's Whistle is provided as an objective for Aqir Instincts and Honing Instincts.
Gushing Lacerations is an Azerite trait available to Feral druids.
__NOTOC__ Gustav is a venthyr located at the Old Gate in Revendreth.
Gurtuk Hardshell is a tortollan located in the Jeweled Coast in Stormsong Valley.
Gusting Soldiers are unbound air elementals located at the Roiling Vortex in Nazjatar.
The Habanero Brew are barrels with habaneros in them found in the Mama's Pantry in the Stormstout Brewery. They create explosions when damaged.
Gwynceirw is a vorkai located in the Root Cellar of Ardenweald. Daffodil and Gwynceirw are also occasionally found up in the Shrouded Mire, where they fight a Rotbriar Boggart.
The Gut Bomb is provided as an objective for Boom Bait. Rivett Clutchpop created it from guts of Hungry Bloodtalons. It is used to kill the fish in Murky Bank in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Guy Yearmo is a dredger located in Sinfall. He upgrades Venthyr Covenant equipment.
Gutwrench Ring drops from The Butcher in Highmaul and is looted from Cache of Highmaul Treasures.

Gwyarbrawden is an ancient dwarven ritual and the most prominent of blood connections between common dwarven warriors. Those who swear Gwyarbrawden to each other mark themselves as willing to cross all of Azeroth to avenge their comrade should they die. It is a form of justice all unto itself, and legends about Gwyarbrawden quests often finish with detailed descriptions of the prey's long and grisly death. Dwarven clan leaders do not publicly acclaim its existence, but neither do they condemn it, and it is a part of dwarven society that very few outsiders know about. The ritual predates the War of the Three Hammers. The skardyn are familiar with stories of Gwyarbrawden, but it's unknown if t
Guttered Crypt Candle is looted from Cryptkeeper Kassir's Disgruntled Gift in the Ember Court.
Gus is a retriever soulshape located next to Sir Reginald in Ardenweald.
Gutshot's Trophy Hunter drops from Gutshot in Brackenhide Hollow.
Gyasi Ra'lar is a jungle troll located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. They are found with a few other druids: Chumbergo, Aona Kaseldri and Keese Featherhoof.
Gwosh is a hornswog who lives on the shore at the north end of Iskaara in the Azure Span. Gentle but fierce, he loves to engage in pet battles.
Gusting Proto-Dragons are proto-dragons located in the Halls of Infusion.
Gurubashi Carver is created with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Gurubashi Carver.
Gurubashi Headplate is created with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Gurubashi Headplate.
Gurubashi Poker is created with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Gurubashi Poker.

Gurubashi Ceremonial Staff is created with Inscription (300); taught by Ancient Technique: Gurubashi Ceremonial Staff.
Gurubashi Grinder is created with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Gurubashi Grinder.
Gurubashi Hoodoo Stick is created with Inscription (300); taught by Ancient Technique: Gurubashi Hoodoo Stick.
Gurubashi Slicer is created with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Gurubashi Slicer.
Hacker of Raging Tempests is sold by Mythressa for and Rethelshi in Valdrakken for .

Haleh is a blue dragon quest giver found near the entrance to Mazthoril in Winterspring. At the conclusion of the Nexus War, Haleh became the last living consort of Malygos, and the first consort ever to outlive a Dragon Aspect.
Hakkari Thorium Veins are deposits of Thorium found inside Zul'Gurub. They yield Souldarite, Thorium Ore, and several gems such as Arcane Crystal and Azerothian Diamond.

The Hall of Explorers, also called the Assembly of Explorers, is a major district in the dwarven capital of Ironforge and the headquarters of the famed Explorers' League. Every archaeological expedition organized by the Alliance is coordinated from here, while it also houses one of the most complete museums of artifacts in the world. The Hall of Explorers is always ready to entertain, educate, and especially inform the agents of the SI:7. At first glance, the Hall of Explorers seems like a museum with all the interesting artifacts collected by the League. But few people are familiar with the excellent, and unofficial, relationship between SI:7 and the Explorers' League. Which leads the High

Half-ogre (or Mok'nathal) is a term used to describe the half-breed offspring of an ogre, or half-ogre parent, and an orc. Most of them are found within the Mok'Nathal clan. The mok'nathal were considered half-breeds, lesser than true orcs, by the Old Horde. However, times changed under the New Horde, and their inclusion at the first Kosh'harg festival held on Azeroth could potentially put an end to their isolationist policy in Outland.
Hadoken Swiftstrider is a tauren quest giver located at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Hakkari Shadow Hunters are jungle trolls found in Zul'Gurub.
Hai'zan is a jungle troll meat vendor located in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
The Hakkari Urn stores several treasures belonging to the trolls in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
The Hakkari Shroud is a cloth hood that gives a bonus to stamina and intellect. It is part of a treasure hoard in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
The Hakkari Breastplate is a leather chestpiece that gives a bonus to stamina and agility. It is part of a treasure hoard in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Hailstone Band is a ring for frost resistance gear, ideal for rogues and warriors.
Hakkari Blood drops from Hakkari Bloodkeeper in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Halija Whitestrider is a tauren cloth armor vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Hagg Taurenbane is a rare quilboar found in Blackthorn Ridge in the Southern Barrens. He is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer.
__NOTOC__ Haljan Oakheart is a night elf general goods vendor located in Astranaar in Ashenvale.
Haggle is a leper gnome located on the Ironforge side of the Deeprun Tram who is often seen wandering aimlessly, sifting through the trash, talking to himself, and sleeping.
Hakkari Loa Cloak is a piece of back armor. The bonuses to intellect, spirit, and the healing bonus makes it ideal for any spellcaster except Paladins.
Hagar Lightninghoof is a tauren quest giver located in Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, presumably having been killed in the Thousand Needles disaster.
Hahk'Zor is rare ogre located at Dreadmaul Rock in the Burning Steppes.
The Halaa Research Token is a PVP token earned by quest turn-ins in Nagrand, akin to Battlegrounds tokens. They are generally used in conjunction with s to purchase various rewards in Halaa.

Halaa Battle Token is created whenever you or your group/raid kills a player of the opposing faction around Halaa. Only kills that would grant your character Honor/Experience will provide you with a Battle Token. As of Warlords of Draenor, tokens can be obtained from a Garrison Mission Mysteries of Lok-rath which awards 100 Halaa Battle Token and 40 Halaa Research Token upon completion.
__NOTOC__ Haggrum Bloodfist is an orc quest giver located at the Northern Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. He previously resided at Valormok.

The Haldarr Encampment was located in western Azshara, northeast of Shadowsong Shrine and southwest of old Valormok. It was densely populated by Haldarr satyr, the death of which is an objective of a quest. Sentinel Keldara Sunblade laid injured, captured or was consorting here. Since the Cataclysm, the ruins, the encampment and its inhabitants are nowhere to be found, with Gallywix Pleasure Palace occupying the subzone's area.
Hahrana Ironhide is a tauren master leatherworking trainer located in Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Hakkari Frostwings are wind serpents found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Hakkari Sappers are wind serpents found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Haferet is a draenei leatherworking vendor located at the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.
Hai'shulud is a bone worm of the Bone Wastes in Terokkar Forest. He is known as .
__NOTOC__ Hagash the Blind is an orc bow vendor located at Spinebreaker Post in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Halaani Whiskey is a consumable sold by and in Halaa in Nagrand when your faction has control of the town. The increased "desire to converse" has no in-game effect.

The Halaa Blade Merchant is a vendor in the PvP-capturable town of Halaa in Nagrand. This vendor sells various poor and common weapons as well as two uncommon weapons, a rare gem, and two different types of the epic Talbuk mount. This NPC is known as Coreiel when the Horde controls Halaa and Aldraan when the Alliance control Halaa.
Half-Buried Bottles are found on the sandy beaches of the east coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Halaani Basin is a deep cleft below Halaa in central Nagrand. It is populated by water elementals, and leads north into Northwind Cleft and south into Southwind Cleft, which are both full of ogres. Mo'mor the Breaker in Telaar asks Alliance adventurers to kill ogres here for the quest The Twin Clefts of Nagrand.
Halaani Razorshaft was sold by the following in Halaa in Nagrand: * Banro * Tasaldan Each faction's vendor will only be available when that faction controls Halaa.

Half-draenei is a term used to describe the half-breed offspring of one draenei parent, or half-draenei, and a parent of any other species, such as an orc. The term half-orc can also be used. According to Lantresor of the Blade, his kind are a rare breed, with most having been killed decades ago. Half-orc, half-draenei are reviled and scorned by both draenei and orc cultures. However, times changed under the New Horde, as Lantresor and Garona Halforcen were included at the first Kosh'harg festival held on Azeroth. According to Garona, being half-blooded used to mark one as an outcast among the orcs, but she then mused that it was now a thing of the past, and that she could possibly join one
Haggard's Axe is a quest reward from Dead-tooth Jack. It belonged to Marshal Haggard from when he served as a Stormwind Marshal.
Haggard's Dagger is a quest reward from Dead-tooth Jack. It belonged to Marshal Haggard from when he served as a Stormwind Marshal.
Haggard's Hammer is a quest reward from Dead-tooth Jack. It belonged to Marshal Haggard from when he served as a Stormwind Marshal.
Haggard's Sword is a quest reward from Dead-tooth Jack. It belonged to Marshal Haggard from when he served as a Stormwind Marshal.
Halaani Grimshot was sold by: Banro and Tasaldan in Halaa in Nagrand. Each faction's vendor will only be available when that faction controls Halaa.
Halberd of Desolation is an epic polearm. It has stats suited for DPS Classes as it has many damaging altering stats, ideal for a Hunter and an MS warrior .

Halaani Claymore is sold by Aldraan, a merchant who appears in Haala, Nagrand when the Alliance has control of Haala. This item is sold in limited quantities. The Horde equivalent is Arkadian Claymore.
Hail, Commander! is a reward quest for reaching reputation with Netherwing.

The Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility plays a large part in the druid quest Trial of the Sea Lion, part of the Aquatic Form quest chain. When combined with the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance, this creates the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

The Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance plays a large part in the druid quest Trial of the Sea Lion, part of the Aquatic Form quest chain. When combined with the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility, this creates the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

Half-ogre mage is the term for the theoretical offspring between ogre magi and orcs. Ogre magi were creations of Gul'dan during the Second War, but they refused to mate with orcs for the purpose of creating mok'nathal. Their existence is rare if unlikely. Like all half-ogres, half-ogre magi speak Low Common and Common. Their ogre progenitors were once part of the Horde, and some learn the languages of other savage creatures. They may also speak Goblin, Orcish, Taur-ahe, and Zandali.

Halgrind was a vrykul town found in Howling Fjord. During the war against the Lich King, Halgrind was exposed to the New Plague, serving as a testing ground for the Royal Apothecary Society. When the Forsaken took control of the town, the chieftain Thorvald fled. The remaining vrykul, while not dropping dead from exposure, found themselves trapped and slowly killed. After the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard mentioned that the village was still in ruins and a patch of blighted land.
Hakkari Bloodkeepers are wind serpents found in Sunken Temple.

The Hall of Gears is located within Gnomeregan, and lies just beyond the Clockwerk Run. It has one upper level, which is completely taken over by irradiated troggs; and a lower level, which holds puddles of radioactive fallout, numerous oozes, poison elementals, and a mini-boss . The Hall of Gears' upper level has two exits: the first, to the southeast, is a dead-end hallway featuring and her collapsing-tunnels event with the first mini-boss, ; the second, to the southwest, leads to the Clean Zone and the Dormitory. The lower level has one entrance (on the south, from the Dormitory), and one exit (to the west, a winding tunnel leads to the Launch Bay. Jumping from the upper to the lower leve
Half-giant is a term used to describe two different races: the vrykul and the djaradin. The exact meaning of the term is unclear.

The Hall of Ritual is located inside the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It is full of Atal'ai trolls and mummified zombies, and is lined along the walls by skull statues. The Hall of Ritual leads from the Den of the Caller, and descends via a staircase to the Hall of Bones below.

The Hall of Serpents is located inside the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It is full of bog beasts, oozes, maggots, worms, and a single Spawn of Hakkar. It is a circular hallway leading out to the six ledges containing serpentine statues that overlook the Pit of Refuse. It is accessed from the center-right and center-left passages upon entering through the instance portal, and by heading down the stairs rather than up. Upon pressing the snake statues on those ledges in the proper order, the dire troll boss Atal'alarion spawns in the middle of the pit. The altar showing the proper order of the statues sits at the top of the staircase leading down onto the water-covered pit floor.

The Hall of Secrets is located deep within Scholomance. It is accessed from the Headmaster's Study via the northern doorway on the upper level. Lorekeeper Polkelt can be found here, presiding over a large number of zombies. This room is possibly the toughest of the six to clear, as the zombies spread a nasty disease and explode upon death.

The Hall of Lights is located inside the Scarlet Bastion, and it is the main thoroughfare of the building. It leads down past a locked door to the Hoard, and in a separate direction on to the Crimson Throne. Malor the Zealous, the Crimson Hammersmith, and Archivist Galford can all be found in chambers adjoining the hall, which is heavily patrolled by the Crimson Legion.

The Hall of Blackhand is the outermost area of Blackrock Spire, and holds both the locked access door to Upper Blackrock Spire on the north wall, as well as the open entrances to Lower Blackrock Spire on the south wall. The Hall of Blackhand also has an upper level beyond the Rookery, just before the Blackrock Stadium. This is where Goraluk Anvilcrack and Jed Runewatcher appear. Both levels of the hall are full of orcs, both stationary and patrolling.
Hae'Wilani is a jungle troll axe vendor located in Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
The Hakkari Grounds are an area of Zul'Gurub, accessed by turning right and then going south past the Coil, then walking on a hill. This area is commanded by Bloodlord Mandokir.

A halberd is usually described as a two-handed pole weapon with an axe blade, topped with a spike mounted on a long shaft. Gladiators used these. It seems that Grimthorn Redbeard used his own halberd to cook. Tauren halberds are used by tauren chieftains. Humans on Kul Tiras use halberds as well.

The Hall of Justice was located in Stratholme. It was here that the trial of Tirion Fordring took place for treason and where he was excommunicated by Uther the Lightbringer. An enormous white flag bearing a stylized blue letter, which signified the Alliance of Lordaeron, stood in this grandiose chamber. Lining the vast walls of the chamber were other huge banners representing the seven nations of the Alliance. A large blue banner embroidered with a golden lion signified the kingdom of Stormwind. Another banner, black with a red-gauntleted fist, represented the kingdom of Stromgarde. Others also were present.
Haliscan Jacket is crafted with Tailoring (265); taught by Pattern: Haliscan Jacket.
Haliscan Pantaloons are crafted with Tailoring (245); taught by Pattern: Haliscan Pantaloons.
Hailstone Pendant drops from Lord Ahune in the Heroic Slave Pens during the Midsummer Fire Festival.

__NOTOC__ The Hailstone Lieutenant is a summoned water elemental in Desolace. He can be summoned by touching an Ice Stone as part of the Midsummer Fire Festival. As a water elemental, it is intrinsically immune to spells in the frost school.

High Commander Halford Wyrmbane is a mighty paladin at the head of the 7th Legion. Once a knight in the ranks of the Alliance of Lordaeron who fought against the orcs during the Second War, he later became a paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand, before taking the leadership of the 7th Legion. As their High Commander, he led this elite special ops regiment composed of veterans in many battles, bringing victory to the Alliance on numerous occasions, including the Battle of Mount Hyjal at the time of the Third War. __NOTOC__ Hair Trigger sold by many engineering suppliers. They can also be "skinned" by engineers from corpses of mechanicals in Northrend.

Hadronox is the second boss of Azjol-Nerub, an instance in the Dragonblight. When encountered, the Anub'ar are attacking him as the players enter the room. It seems like the Scourge forces here are trying to catch the huge spider and perhaps convert it to an undead to use as a weapon, similar to Maexxna in Naxxramas.
Halefnir the Windborn is a lightning revenant found at the Terrace of the Makers in the Storm Peaks.
Hail To The King, Baby is an achievement related to the seasonal world event Children's Week. Completing this achievement is part of the meta achievement For the Children.
The Hall of Horrors is located within The Underhalls in Icecrown. Nergeld are found here.
Haley Copperturn is an engineering vendor found at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.
Hailstorm can be found inside Alexstrasza's Gift after defeating Malygos in the 10-man version of the Eye of Eternity.
Hadronox Denied is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Hadronox in Azjol-Nerub on Heroic difficulty before he webs the top doors and prevents more creatures from spawning.
Hadronox's Lair is a large room within Azjol-Nerub that has several Nerubians making sure Hadronox doesn't escape.

The Hall of Departure is the main entrance and exit hallway in Drak'Tharon Keep. When you first enter a couple of ice trolls are running to escape only to be killed and raised by scourge necromancers.
The Hall of Return is the hallway one takes that leads from the Fall of Return to the Hall of Departure in Drak'Tharon Keep. Only dead ice trolls can be found here, nothing more.

The Hall of Repose is more of a room than a hall. It sits at the end of the Hall of the High Father in the Halls of Stone. Maiden of Grief is found here. Another Hall of Repose is a room inside the main building of the Shaper's Terrace. pl:Hall of Repose

Hail to the Chef is the meta-achievement for the secondary skill cooking. You will need to acquire a fair amount of fish as well as meat and other food reagents (such as fruit and alcohol) to complete this achievement. Also much world travel to vendors across classic WoW, Outland and Northrend will be required, as well as completion of many Dalaran daily cooking quests.
__NOTOC__ Hailscorn is an elite frost wyrm found in the Avalanche of Sholazar Basin.

Hakmud of Argus is one of two Alliance traveling vendors preloaded with the Reins of the Traveler's Tundra Mammoth. Hakmud sells reagents, ammo and Draenic Silk Robes to any Alliance aligned player. In Eredath, Hakmud can be found alone at Azurelight Square.

The Hall of Memories is a subzone of Ulduar at the 8 o'clock exit of the Observation Ring. Its entrance is denoted by two saronite crystals. The Ancient Gate of the Keepers blocks the way to the Descent into Madness and is unlocked after defeating the Keepers of Ulduar: Thorim, Hodir, Freya, and Mimiron.
Halig Fireforge supplies the Argent Crusade in Argent Vanguard with blacksmithing supplies. He was present during Death Rising.
Hairy Herring Heads contains Hairy Herring Heads. These are located on the shelves in Finklestein's Laboratory at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.
Hakkar is the last boss of Zul'Gurub. If you kill Hakkar successfully, you receive +400 reputation with the Zandalar Tribe.

The Hall of Command is the center of the first floor of Acherus: The Ebon Hold. This is where Highlord Darion Mograine commands the death knights of the Ebon Blade. Death knight trainers can be found on this floor, on the outer edges.
Halion, Staff of Forgotten Love drops from the Lich King in the 10-man version of Icecrown Citadel.

The Haldarr clan's satyr set their Haldarr Encampment in the west of Azshara. Keldara Sunblade lies sleeping and most likely captured in this camp. After the Cataclysm, neither the satyrs, nor Keldara can be found, as the area was strip-mined by the Bilgewater goblins.
Half-Burnt Torch is provided as an objective for for Knee-Deep.

Halcyon Egress is a mostly empty area the separates Therazane's Throne from Twilight Precipice in Deepholm. It's here that Therazane's forces gather for the assault upon the Twilight's Hammer with the aid of the Earthen Ring.
Halga's "Street Sweeper" is provided as an objective for the following quests: *Crossroads Caravan Pickup *Crossroads Caravan Delivery *Mor'shan Caravan Delivery (not as an objective, but still used)

Halfus Wyrmbreaker is the first boss of Bastion of Twilight, a raid instance in the Twilight Highlands. He can be found in the Wyrmbreaker's Rookery, overlooking a lava pit and facing his guardian, the Proto-Behemoth. He is considered a fairly easy fight. Halfus was beaten along with the other bosses in the first week of Cataclysm's release, but the heroic modes proved more difficult. The world first kills came on Wednesday, 15 December 2010.

Halga Bloodeye is an orc quest giver found at the Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens. She defended the Post during the Legion invasions.
Haethen Kaul is the leader of the Twilight's Hammer's operations at the Twilight Terrace in Deepholm.
Halford may refer to: * Crusader Halford, a member of the Argent Crusade. * Halford Ramsey, a detective from Gilneas. * Halford Wyrmbane, the leader of the 7th Legion.
Hakkari Loa Drape drops from Bloodlord Mandokir in Zul'Gurub.
Half Truth Handlers is a quest reward from Secrets in the Oasis.
Half-Eaten Coalpelt Bears are dead black bears found inside the cave at Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in Duskwood.
Hagara the Stormbinder is the fourth boss to appear in the Dragon Soul raid. World first heroic kill on 25-man achieved 7.12.2011 by Blood Legion - US-Illidan.
Hag's Broom is an animated object provided by Gertrude Fenlow in Elwynn Forest for the quest Stink Bombs Away! (Alliance).
Hagrim Hopebreaker is a kvaldir seen while viewing the past during Final Judgment.
__NOTOC__ Halannia is a forest nymph found at Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale.

Halfhill is the center of commerce in the Valley of the Four Winds, found more or less in the dead-center of the zone. It is a large community built onto a hill, several roads crisscrossing between houses on the hillsides. It is also the headquarters of the Tillers, a faction dedicated to farming. The outskirts of the town near the bottom of the hill hold granaries, a boat builder's workshop, Sunsong Ranch, and the all-important Halfhill Market. The town's tavern, the Lazy Turnip, lies about halfway up the hill, next to a flattened plaza. The upper levels of the hill hold several more houses. Among them is the headquarters of the Tillers Union where Nana Mudclaw stays, where once stood Shen-

The Halfhill Market is a market place on the southwestern end of Halfhill in central Valley of the Four Winds. It's from here the farmers in the valley come to sell and trade their goods. Many visitors also come here looking for unique foods and to buy the goods offered.
Halfhill Villagers are pandaren located around Halfhill and Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Half-Eaten Fish is a grummle located in front of Shado-Pan Monastery in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Hall of Statues is a part of the Guo-Lai Halls, down the ramp and to the left. Past the hall of statues is the Guo-Lai Vault.

Hai-pu is a form of hozen writing. Small scrolls containing hai-pu can be found at various locations in Pandaria, and can be read by players. 5 different scrolls of hai-pu are currently known to exist.
The Hall of Shapers is a hallway leading from the Repository to the Engine of Nalak'sha and Forge of the Endless in the Mogu'shan Vaults.
The Hair of the Chamberlain can be found at various locations in either the Conqueror's Terrace or the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

Hagut is a Blizzard employee and an English and Portuguese Customer Support Representative for the European World of Warcraft community. He can be found on the [http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/forum/975485/ English] and [http://eu.battle.net/wow/pt/forum/3363454/ Portuguese] Customer Support forums.
Haelgond is a vrykul mentioned by her son. The Forsaken have provoked him by speaking ill of her.

The Hall of Kings is the grand entrance, from the Grand Courtyard, into the fortress of the Thunder King. Four Shan'ze Celestial Shapers can be found here preforming some ritual with essences of the August Celestials. Killing each shaper frees an essence to assist with the Twin Consorts. * * * *
__NOTOC__ The Half-Empty Food Container drops from Quivering Filth at Ihgaluk Crag on Isle of Thunder.
Hai-Me Heavyhands is a level 90 pandaren located at Setting Sun Garrison of Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

The Halberd of the Unscathed is the amber polearm formerly wielded by the Klaxxi Paragon Malik the Unscathed. Malik held the weapon in his last battle with Imperial Vizier Zor'lok. The halberd was later recovered. The weapon can be found in Klaxxi'vess on a weapon rack. It can grant the player Malik's Klaxxi Enhancement, Iron Mantid, perhaps referencing Malik's words during The Empress' Gambit: "Heroes never die, !"
Haggard Refugees were humans once found at the Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest.

Haiyun Greentill is a pandaren located at the Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Hal'Nazris is a nathrezim located at the in Tanaan Jungle.

The Hall of Shadows is the headquarters of a clandestine organization known as the Uncrowned, serving as the Order Hall for rogues. It is located in the southwestern section of the Underbelly, where the Cantrips & Crows tavern is found. Even so, the Hall of Shadows cannot be entered from the rest of the Underbelly, instead, its entrances are located in a number of stores around Dalaran: Glorious Goods, Tanks for Everything, and in One More Glass. The exit pipe leading to the outside of Dalaran can also be used to enter it, albeit only rogues can enter into the Hall.
The Half-Eaten Banana is looted from the Clumsy Cragmaul Brute found dead high on a ledge on the Stonefury Cliffs overlooking the Coldsnap Bluffs at the northern end of Frostfire Ridge.
The Haft of the God-King is one of the components for making The Dragonslayers.
Hall of Arcane Learning is a section of the Nar'thalas Academy in Azsuna.
Hafr Fjall is an area on the cliffs of southeastern Stormheim. It overlooks the Blackhawk's Bulwark.
Hag's Belongings is a quest reward from Under the Crooked Tree.
Halfdan is a bear located in a camp in Hrydshal in Stormheim. It is Huntress Estrid's pet.
Hakkap One-leg is a banner hanging in the Tomb of the Old Kings on Shield's Rest in Stormheim.

The Hall of Balance is a subzone of Netherlight Temple, it is the primary room of the class hall with several different areas in the hall housing different NPCs with different functions. The mission board is found in the center with the artifact forge on the northern platform.
Hadrox is an eredar brute located at the Stasis Core in the Antoran Wastes.

Hakkari Oracles are jungle trolls located in Stranglethorn Vale.
Hakkari Minions are serpents located in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
